name: RouteAIModel
title: 按策略自动选模型
description: 依据 cheapest/fastest/fallback/round_robin 策略选择最终调用模型，落 AIRoutingDecision 工件
preconditions: 至少一个候选 model.status = active 且 quotaRemainingCents > 0
effects: 从 candidate pool (AIAgentRuntime.primaryModelId + fallbackModelIds) 中按策略筛选
插入 AIRoutingDecision 记录 (invocationId 占位，调用 completed 时回填)
